description: This file is a shell script used to detect and analyze how Unicode NFC and NFD forms are handled on the filesystem. It includes tests to determine if NFC and NFD path spellings are preserved or collide on disk, with additional tests for double decompositions involving multiple combining characters. The script contains definitions of sample Unicode strings in NFC and NFD forms and performs filesystem operations and hexdump analyses to gather information about unicode normalization handling on the host system.
